JioHotstar account-flag fix. The re-signed build was sending IsTampered=true in the device-attestation blob (Kg/b) it posts to the server, which locked the account 24h for "suspicious activity" (error NM-4290). Adds "Spoof device attestation": forces all 8 attestation security flags (IsEmulator/IsRooted/IsTampered/IsProxy/isVpnActive/isSuspiciousFileExists/isPortsOpen/isDebuggerEnabled) to false at the blob constructor, so the app reports a clean device. WARNING: this only removes a client-sent signal — the server still sees the VPN exit IP and an already-flagged account stays on Hotstars radar. Do NOT run on an account you cannot afford to lose; test on a throwaway Jio number first. Other apps unchanged.

Adds three native Android TV OTT apps (all clean re-sign, no anti-tamper). JioHotstar (in.startv.hotstar 26.06.22.3): novel VPN/proxy-block bypass (device-confirmed India VPN + playback), remove ads, integrity spoof, analytics off, AD_ID, premium UI, screenshots/mirroring/4K/HDR, change name. Vi Movies and TV (com.vimtv 10.8): remove ads, analytics off, AD_ID, change name, premium UI. JioTV+ (com.jio.media.jiotvplus 2.6.4_2076): remove ads (JioAds + player VMAP), analytics off, AD_ID, change name. Existing apps unchanged (SonyLIV, Nutrilio, Threads, Arrow Puzzle, CrazyGames). Ads/premium are client-side; real content stays server-entitlement + Widevine gated. JioHotstar ad/premium/UX hooks adapted from Paresh-Maheshwari (GPL-3.0).

CrazyGames interstitial fix. Mid-game interstitial ads drove the same loading-overlay state machine as rewarded ads: the web waits for the interstitial Showed and Dismissed lifecycle events to dismiss the overlay. showInterstitial only resolved the call (firing neither event), so it hung. Interstitial events are named differently from rewarded (interstitialAdShowed/interstitialAdDismissed vs onRewarded*); the extension is generalized to fireAdEvents and now fires Showed+Dismissed for interstitial and Reward+Dismissed for rewarded. Other patches unchanged: Bypass Play license check, Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name.

CrazyGames rewarded-ad fix. The auto-reward was firing only the Reward listener event, but the web finishes the rewarded flow (credits the reward and dismisses the loading overlay) on the Dismissed event, gated on Reward having fired first. So it stuck on the loading screen. Now fires Reward then Dismissed (in order) for both showRewardVideoAd and showRewardInterstitialAd, then resolves the call. Other patches unchanged: Bypass Play license check, Remove ads, Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name.

CrazyGames fix — adds "Bypass Play license check". The 1.14.0 build was redirected to the Play Store on launch ("get it on Google Play"): root cause is Google Play Automatic Integrity Protection (PairIP), com.pairip.licensecheck.LicenseClient, which fails the licensing verdict on a re-signed sideload and redirects to the store. This patch neuters both LicenseClient entry points so the check never runs; it is on by default and required for the patched app to open. No PairIP code-virtualization (VMRunner) in this build, so it is safe. Other CrazyGames patches unchanged (Remove ads incl. auto-reward, Disable analytics, Remove AD_ID, Change app name; package kept so login works).

CrazyGames (com.crazygames.crazygamesapp 1.6.7) added — a Capacitor WebView app. Remove ads (native AdMob: interstitial/banner hidden; rewarded ads auto-grant their reward without playing a video), Disable analytics (native Sentry telemetry), Remove AD_ID, Change app name -> "CrazyGames Morphe" (package kept so Google/Facebook/Apple login still works). Note: in-page web video ads served remotely inside the WebView are not in the app bytecode and remain. Other apps unchanged: SonyLIV 6.23.1, Nutrilio 1.20.2, Threads 434.0.0.41.74, Arrow Puzzle 1.7.0.

## Pepper PL 8.13.02 prebuilt variants

Maintenance release: **patches and `.mpp` bundle are byte-equivalent to v1.0.0** — the only change is a fresh set of four prebuilt XAPKs targeting Pepper PL **8.13.02** (versionCode 81302) instead of 8.13.00.

If you build through Morphe Manager / `morphe-cli` you can keep using v1.0.0's bundle — there is no patch delta. The new release exists so that anyone grabbing a ready XAPK doesn't have to start from the old 8.13.00 base.

> 📦 **Also on ReVanced** → [pepper-revanced-patches v1.4.1](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches/releases/tag/v1.4.1) — same patch set, upstream [ReVanced Patcher](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-patcher) bundle for [ReVanced Manager](https://github.com/ReVanced/revanced-manager).

### What changed in Pepper 8.13.02 (upstream)

Diffed against 8.13.00 — the delta is one new feature plus the usual build-time noise. **None of it touches any patch's fingerprint surface**, so every patch from v1.0.0 applies unchanged:

| Layer | Change |
|---|---|
| New feature | **Views Challenge** — weekly-visit Club-points streak system: 15 new `views_challenge_*` strings, 1 plural, 1 vector drawable (`branding_mascot_smiling.xml`), corresponding DEX |
| Strings | +15 in base APK; same 15 translated in `config.de` / `config.es` / `config.fr` splits (+4 KB each) |
| `AndroidManifest.xml` (decoded) | **no semantic change** |
| Permissions | **no change** |
| `target_sdk` / `min_sdk` | 36 / 24 — unchanged |
| Noise | Crashlytics `mapping_file_id`, `version-control-info.textproto` revision, R8 service renames (`c95→e95`, `i18→r18`, `rr2→sr2` under `META-INF/services/`), regenerated `baseline.prof` / `baseline.profm` |

All 14 patches apply cleanly. Verified end-to-end against the APKPure 8.13.02 XAPK.

### Prebuilt XAPK variants

Same 2×2 matrix as v1.0.0 (debug menu × compact cards):

| File | Debug menu | Compact cards |
|---|---|---|
| `pepperpl-8.13.02.xapk` | ✗ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug.xapk` | ✓ | ✗ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-compact.xapk` | ✗ | ✓ |
| `pepperpl-8.13.02-debug-compact.xapk` | ✓ | ✓ |

Each XAPK ships:
- patched **base** APK (DEX-rewritten, all default-on patches applied)
- `config.arm64_v8a` + `config.xxxhdpi` splits
- `config.en` + `config.pl` language splits

For any other ABI / DPI / language combo, grab the matching split from the unpatched APKPure 8.13.02 XAPK and side-load alongside via `adb install-multiple`.

## Morphe port — v1.0.0

This is the **first release of the Morphe port** of [pepper-revanced-patches](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches). The patch set and prebuilt APK variants mirror the upstream ReVanced **v1.4.0** release one-for-one — same fingerprints, same smali stubs, same telemetry coverage — but compiled against [Morphe Patcher 1.5.0](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patcher/releases/tag/v1.5.0) for the [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) ecosystem.

If you came here looking for the ReVanced equivalent, it lives at [PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches](https://github.com/PawiX25/pepper-revanced-patches).

---

### Visual diff

**Pixel 10a (420 dpi):**

**Pixel 9 Pro XL (480 dpi):**
![Pixel 9 Pro XL — before / after](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PawiX25/pepper-morphe-patches/screenshots/screenshots/emu-comparison.png?v=2)

Same `Najgorętsze` tab on both devices. **Left of each pair:** the standard

This release adds patch **#7 Compact deal cards** and reorganises the prebuilt
APKs around a 2×2 matrix (debug menu × compact cards), so you can pick the
exact combination you want without flipping toggles in Morphe Manager.

### What's new

#### Patch #7 — Compact deal cards (opt-in)
Resource-only patch that shrinks the redesigned 8.x deal-list cards and their
loading skeletons toward the denser pre-redesign density. Targeted XML edits
to `item_deal_thread_card.xml`, `item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and
`item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`.

Per-element changes (real card):

| Element | Original | After patch | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `thread_image` | 108×108dp, marginTop=8 | **92×92dp**, marginTop=4, marginBottom=8 | smaller thumbnail with a guaranteed 8 dp gap above the comment row |
| `deal_thread_button_vote_*` | 36×36dp | **32×32dp** | thinner up/down vote pills |
| `deal_thread_text_temperature` | `Subtitle2` + minHeight 36 + body2 autosize | **`CaptionBold`** + minHeight 32 + caption autosize | 2-3 digit temperature fits the new 92 dp temperature box |
| `top_barrier barrierMargin` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | tighter gap below the optional sponsored header |
| `thread_text_title` | maxLines=4, marginTop=8, vertical_bias=0.5 | **maxLines=2**, marginTop=4, vertical_bias=0.25 | title clamps to 2 lines and hugs the top of its space |
| `thread_text_username marginBottom` | 8 dp | **4 dp** | less padding above the get-deal button |
| `thread_button_comment_count` | 48×48 dp, Start=parent | **32×32 dp**, Start=guideline_start | smaller comment button that respects the card's left guideline |
| `comment_count` | maxWidth=38, marginStart=38, Start=button | **maxWidth=42, gravity=center_vertical, height=32, Start_toEndOf=button** | comment count number renders **next to** the button instead of overlapping it via the original `marginStart=38dp` hack |
| `deal_thread_button_get_deal*` (×3) | wrap_content + Material default insets | **minHeight=40dp + insetTop=0 + insetBottom=0** + Baseline_toBaselineOf removed | the Material3 Button.Icon style ships with `insetTop=6dp`/`insetBottom=6dp` defaults — on a 40 dp View that leaves only 28 dp of orange button area, which clipped the Subtitle2 text. Zeroing the insets restores the full 40 dp visible area. |

Skeleton (`item_deal_voucher_placeholder_card.xml` and `item_sponsored_thread_placeholder_card.xml`):
- `placeholder_temperature_box` 108×36 → **92×32**
- `placeholder_image` 108×108 → **92×92**
- `placeholder_text_title` height 52 → **24** (single bar instead of two-line block)
- `placeholder_date / merchant / username` width 104 → **80**
- `placeholder_button_get_deal` height stays at 40 but margins drop 8 → **4**
- `placeholder_comment_and_share` 64×24 → **48×32** (matches the real comment button's 32 dp height)
- sponsored-only: `thread_header_text minHeight` 32 → **24** (smaller "SPONSORED" header bar)

All placeholder dimensions now match the real card 1:1, so the loading skeleton
snaps to the final layout instead of jumping when data arrives.

The patch is **opt-in** (`default = false`) — it only runs when you tick it in
Morphe Manager, or pass `-e "Compact deal cards"` to the CLI.

## [1.0.3](https://github.com/RookieEnough/De-ReVanced/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3) (2026-04-02)

### Bug Fixes

* release v1.0.3 with Google Recorder fix ([c03c701](https://github.com/RookieEnough/De-ReVanced/commit/c03c701a6ba658afb4f4f2093faca9e6bc91e49c))

* **Google Recorder — Remove device restrictions:** fingerprint and bytecode hook updated for current app builds — match `RecorderApplication.onCreate` without a fixed feature string, detect any `com.google.android.feature…PIXEL…` `const-string`, and apply the restriction bypass (fixes fingerprint mismatch on newer Recorder versions).

### Maintenance

* **Attribution:** add a standard `Forked from` source header across Kotlin sources that were still missing it.

### Morphe Manager integration

* Bumped Morphe Gradle plugin to **1.2.0** and **morphe-patcher** to **1.3.3** (GitHub Packages: `gpr.user` / `gpr.key`).
* All patches declare **`compatibleWith(Compatibility(...))`** via `AppCompatibilities` so Manager shows human-readable app titles and icon tint colors.
* **`patches-list.json`** now includes a root **`appNames`** map (package → display name) and, for each patch, a **`compatibility`** array with `name`, `packageName`, `appIconColor`, optional `description`, and **`targets`** (version pins). This fixes the detail view where only package IDs appeared after tapping an app.
* **Bundle artwork:** place **`patch-bundle.png`** in the same directory as **`patch-bundles.json`** so Morphe Manager can show that image instead of the user avatar for the bundle (per upstream guidance).

### Compatibility tuning

* **Google News** (`com.google.android.apps.magazines`): pinned to version **5.108.0.644447823** for all News-related patches.
* **TikTok:** **Settings** and **Enable Open Debug** remain **43.6.2-only** (not supported on 43.8.3); descriptions state this explicitly. Other TikTok patches keep their existing 43.6.2 / 43.8.3 splits.

### New app targets (16)

Patches and extensions were added or expanded for:

1. Bandcamp  
2. Angulus  
3. GMX Mail  
4. Free Phone (GMX)  
5. Hex Editor  
6. Google Recorder  
7. irplus  
8. NU.nl  
9. Nothing X  
10. Peacock TV  
11. Viber  
12. TikTok  
13. Twitch  
14. Adobe Photoshop Mix  
15. Threads  
16. Facebook

# Morphe patch bundle 1.4.91

### Boost for Reddit

### Changes

- Restored hide-on-scroll by keeping Boost's native Material `BottomNavigationView` inside its original `CoordinatorLayout`, allowing the official Material behavior to animate the same view that renders icons, labels, selection indicators, and Inbox badges.
- Removed the runtime dependency on the separate decor-owned navigation clone and translation mirroring that caused partial Inbox badge and Profile selection-indicator remnants.
- Corrected the additional bottom inset on Search and Go to/Subscriptions while preserving the established five-button menu, routing, selected-state handling, reselection behavior, icon tint, and Inbox badge synchronization.

### User impact

The bottom navigation now hides and returns cleanly on Home, Search, Subscriptions, Inbox, and Profile. Search and Subscriptions retain the same vertical alignment as the other destinations, and the previously validated canonical button functions remain unchanged. This release contains the hide-on-scroll portion of Issue #97; the separate long-press account-switcher request remains outside this release.

### THE REAL FIX

Patch CustomerInfo.getActiveSubscriptions() to return a non-empty set.

**Root cause:** The JS app checks `activeSubscriptions.length > 0` FIRST in `hasActiveEntitlementOrSubscription()`. If the user never subscribed, RevenueCat returns an empty set. Our `EntitlementInfo.isActive()` patch was useless because there were ZERO `EntitlementInfo` objects to call it on.

**Fix:** `CustomerInfo.getActiveSubscriptions()` now returns `Collections.singleton("premium")` so JS sees an active subscription and calls `setIsPremiumUser(true)`.

- Add Superwall subscription status bypass to Morolingo Premium.
- Force Superwall Entitlements.setSubscriptionStatus to ACTIVE with a synthetic entitlement.
- Keep existing Pairip and RevenueCat patches.

## v1.0.4\n\nPatches compiled and released.
Breaking change: removed Android Auto support. Project now focuses solely on enabling Petal Maps on non-Huawei devices.

Add in-process display capture via reflection (IWindowManager.captureDisplay on API 34+, SurfaceControl for 29-33) with screencap/PixelCopy fallbacks — fast capture path once the companion LSPosed module unlocks hidden APIs.

Fix black map on the car: capture the COMPOSED virtual display via 'screencap -d' raw (SurfaceView/GL map included — PixelCopy of the window missed it). Header parse with endianness/length validation, auto fallback to PixelCopy, rate-limited path logging.

New render pipeline: the VirtualDisplay draws into its own ImageReader-backed buffer (decoupled from the car surface); a capture loop copies the projected window via PixelCopy every 500ms and draws it on the car surface with crop-to-fill — the letterboxed portrait is stretched to fill the landscape in software. Input goes through the inverse crop mapping. Last frame is kept on capture failure.

Remove forced car mode (power-off/lockscreen — natural behavior preferred) and attack the portrait letterbox: force SENSOR_LANDSCAPE in runtime on the projected activity + explicit resizeableActivity=true in the manifest. Window bounds logged 2s after orientation change for diagnosis.
Fix 100% crash (NavigationTemplate requires an ActionStrip): use a single no-op action instead of the zoom buttons (zoom works via pinch gestures).
Fix 100% crash: restore the NavigationTemplate ActionStrip — androidx.car.app 1.7 requires it (build() throws IllegalStateException without it).

Switch projection target to the standard PetalMapsActivity (forced sensorLandscape via manifest patch), drop the ActionStrip (map fills the car screen, pinch to zoom), and DiLink-style car mode: SCREEN_BRIGHT wakelock + lockscreen off + physical panel power-off (projection keeps rendering, zero panel battery drain).

Fix drag and small centered window: launch with --windowingMode fullscreen (drops stale task bounds), and scroll/fling gestures now anchor at the live window center instead of the last click position.

Fix inverted input and letterboxed portrait layout: AutoPetalMapsActivity screenOrientation now 'unspecified' (follows the car display, no artificial rotation/letterbox); touch dispatch applies window offset + inverse rotation via Matrix (all pointers).

Fix input dying after seconds and letterboxed layout: debounce VirtualDisplay recreation (700ms, host sends a burst of area changes), drop MULTIPLE_TASK (single task reuse), finish the old activity before destroying its display, and only dispatch touch to the live activity instance on the current display.

Fix letterboxed portrait map on the car: never create the VirtualDisplay with portrait dims (automotive activity is landscape-only); reuse last known landscape dims or wait for a landscape update. Also: /sdcard/petal_aa.log now updates at every key car-flow event (surface, display, launch, attach) for remote debugging.

Fix black screen on the car: launch the automotive activity via root 'am start --display <id>' (stock Android blocks launchDisplayId for regular apps). Shared RootShell helper (su --mount-master) between tweaker and CarDisplay; fallback to direct startActivity without root.
Add androidx.car.app.ACCESS_SURFACE permission — the car host throws SecurityException when the app registers its SurfaceCallback without it (crashed PetalSession.onCreateScreen).

Fix ANR on the car: add car-app-api.level to the APK root (androidx.car.app reads it via ClassLoader; without it getAppInfo() threw and the host reported ANR). Also: tweaker now warms up Play Store automatically (deviceidle whitelist + starts PlayGearheadService) — no need to open the Play Store manually.

## Why was the MyoAdapt patch removed?

MyoAdapt's core feature, its adaptive training engine, which plans your next workout based on your completed sessions, runs entirely on MyoAdapt's servers and is fed only by server-side workout history. For accounts without an active subscription, the server hard-blocks (HTTP 402) every action that records or updates a workout.

A client-side patch can fake the workout flow (start, log, finish a session), but the server never learns about any of it: no history, no stats, and the proposed next workout never changes. The patch could therefore never deliver the one thing MyoAdapt is actually worth using for. So rather than shipping something that promises premium but can't deliver it, it has been removed.

## 1.0.0 (2026-08-17)

### ✨ New Features

* publish RuStore privacy patch ([9c3d922](https://github.com/Freeman022026/rustore-privacy-patches/commit/9c3d922b09230e71103cbbde6dbd840cf1f9a5a4))
Breaking change: removed Android Auto support. Project now focuses solely on enabling Petal Maps on non-Huawei devices.

Add in-process display capture via reflection (IWindowManager.captureDisplay on API 34+, SurfaceControl for 29-33) with screencap/PixelCopy fallbacks — fast capture path once the companion LSPosed module unlocks hidden APIs.

Fix black map on the car: capture the COMPOSED virtual display via 'screencap -d' raw (SurfaceView/GL map included — PixelCopy of the window missed it). Header parse with endianness/length validation, auto fallback to PixelCopy, rate-limited path logging.

New render pipeline: the VirtualDisplay draws into its own ImageReader-backed buffer (decoupled from the car surface); a capture loop copies the projected window via PixelCopy every 500ms and draws it on the car surface with crop-to-fill — the letterboxed portrait is stretched to fill the landscape in software. Input goes through the inverse crop mapping. Last frame is kept on capture failure.

Remove forced car mode (power-off/lockscreen — natural behavior preferred) and attack the portrait letterbox: force SENSOR_LANDSCAPE in runtime on the projected activity + explicit resizeableActivity=true in the manifest. Window bounds logged 2s after orientation change for diagnosis.
Fix 100% crash (NavigationTemplate requires an ActionStrip): use a single no-op action instead of the zoom buttons (zoom works via pinch gestures).
Fix 100% crash: restore the NavigationTemplate ActionStrip — androidx.car.app 1.7 requires it (build() throws IllegalStateException without it).

Switch projection target to the standard PetalMapsActivity (forced sensorLandscape via manifest patch), drop the ActionStrip (map fills the car screen, pinch to zoom), and DiLink-style car mode: SCREEN_BRIGHT wakelock + lockscreen off + physical panel power-off (projection keeps rendering, zero panel battery drain).

Fix drag and small centered window: launch with --windowingMode fullscreen (drops stale task bounds), and scroll/fling gestures now anchor at the live window center instead of the last click position.

Fix inverted input and letterboxed portrait layout: AutoPetalMapsActivity screenOrientation now 'unspecified' (follows the car display, no artificial rotation/letterbox); touch dispatch applies window offset + inverse rotation via Matrix (all pointers).

Fix input dying after seconds and letterboxed layout: debounce VirtualDisplay recreation (700ms, host sends a burst of area changes), drop MULTIPLE_TASK (single task reuse), finish the old activity before destroying its display, and only dispatch touch to the live activity instance on the current display.

Fix letterboxed portrait map on the car: never create the VirtualDisplay with portrait dims (automotive activity is landscape-only); reuse last known landscape dims or wait for a landscape update. Also: /sdcard/petal_aa.log now updates at every key car-flow event (surface, display, launch, attach) for remote debugging.

Fix black screen on the car: launch the automotive activity via root 'am start --display <id>' (stock Android blocks launchDisplayId for regular apps). Shared RootShell helper (su --mount-master) between tweaker and CarDisplay; fallback to direct startActivity without root.
Add androidx.car.app.ACCESS_SURFACE permission — the car host throws SecurityException when the app registers its SurfaceCallback without it (crashed PetalSession.onCreateScreen).

Fix ANR on the car: add car-app-api.level to the APK root (androidx.car.app reads it via ClassLoader; without it getAppInfo() threw and the host reported ANR). Also: tweaker now warms up Play Store automatically (deviceidle whitelist + starts PlayGearheadService) — no need to open the Play Store manually.
